home.title: Studying brain pathophysiology across psychiatric diseases including schizophrenia via neuroimaging genetics and machine intelligence approaches.
home.lead: The Mapping Schizophrenia Brain (MSB) group, led by Professor Dr. Yun-Shuang Fan at the School of Life Science and Technology, University of Electronic Science and Technology of China (UESTC), investigates the neural mechanisms of mental disorders using multimodal MRI, connectomics, and spatial transcriptomics, and develops individualized and intelligent diagnosis and treatment enabled by advances in artificial intelligence.

memberjson.title: Member Info Generator
memberjson.lead: Fill in the form below, download your JSON file, and submit it via a pull request — no need to write JSON by hand.
memberjson.name: English name
memberjson.id.hint: Auto-generated from the English name. Lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens only; must match the file name (e.g. san-zhang).
memberjson.dest: Destination after graduation (alumni only, optional, English)
memberjson.dest_zh: Destination after graduation (alumni only, optional, Chinese)
memberjson.photo: I will also upload my photo as assets/people/<id>.jpg (square, ≥400×400px, ≤300KB)
memberjson.saved: Downloaded! Now follow the steps below to submit.
memberjson.error: Please complete all required fields and check the ID format.
memberjson.steps.title: How to submit
memberjson.steps.1: Save the file above as <your-id>.json (the download already uses the right name).
memberjson.steps.2: Open the members folder in the repository and click Add file → Create new file.
memberjson.steps.3: Name it <your-id>.json, paste the content, and choose "Create a new branch for this commit and start a pull request".
memberjson.steps.4: Wait for an admin to review and merge — the website updates about 2 minutes later.
